# Branch secretariat (xingsheng) of the inner provinces: a building-type subject of the Yuan. Copied from the theme type
# oe_empire_theme (OEBYZ in_game/common/subject_types/oe_empire_theme.txt) by way of the Y2 prototype's oe_yx_xingsheng and
# trimmed: no overlord or military bonuses, joins no wars, declares none, no tribute (subject_oe_gov_tax is 0), never joins
# independence wars. Land stays with CHI. The map fields only matter for land subjects; kept so the type follows the overlord.

	subject_pays = subject_oe_gov_tax
	color = subject_samanta
	level = 2
	type = building
	government = monarchy

	join_offensive_wars_always = {
		always = no
	}

		always = no

	can_change_heir_selection = no

	use_overlord_map_name = yes

	great_power_score_transfer = 0.25

	}
